content.contents:
for those of you who wished to peruse this fine piece of art up close. i got a pair back in 2018, feels like forever ago. i loved them. i remember the day after they arrived it was raining, and a package arrived at my door - beach house's 7. i listened to it while on my bed, reading the lyrics from the insert, in a cute pink skirt, kicking my legs back and forth. it was the purest form of euphoria i've ever felt, and i've smoked a lot of fucking pot so that's saying something (LOL).
one of my favorite cover art pieces ever. i think i have yet to meet a t-girl who hasn't owned a pair of these.
